t: An argument made from your own body
a: مَّا لَكُمْ لَا تَرْجُونَ لِلَّهِ وَقَارًا وَقَدْ خَلَقَكُمْ أَطْوَارًا
p: Mā lakum lā tarjūna lillāhi waqārā, wa qad khalaqakum aṭwārā.
m: What is [the matter] with you that you do not attribute to Allāh [due] grandeur While He has created you in stages?
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
